title: Claude Opus 4.8 Integration
description: Claude Opus 4.8 was integrated into GitHub Copilot, marking a significant model update to the Claude family of AI models available in Copilot.

title: Version 0.134.0
description: Added search across local conversation history, made --profile the primary profile selector, improved MCP setup with per-server environment targeting, made connector tool schemas more reliable, and let read-only MCP tools run concurrently.

title: Copilot Memory Improvements
description: Enhanced Copilot Memory functionality with improved controls for data deletion, better scoping options, and new management features specifically for the Copilot CLI.

title: Version 0.133.0
description: Goals now enabled by default with dedicated storage, codex remote-control runs as foreground command, permission profiles gained list APIs and inheritance, plugin discovery improvements, and extensions can observe more lifecycle events.

title: Version 0.43.0
description: Surgical Code Edits with improved edit tool preference, Session Export and Import for portability, and Adaptive Token Estimation for more accurate content size estimation.

title: Cursor 3.5 - Multi-Repo Automations
description: Major update bringing team collaboration features including multi-repository automations and shared canvases for team artifact access.

title: Cursor in Jira Integration
description: Cursor is now available in Jira. Assign work items to Cursor or mention @Cursor in comments to kick off cloud agents.

title: Auto Model Selection in VS Code
description: Enhanced auto model selection capability that routes users to the most appropriate model based on their specific coding task within VS Code.

title: Semantic Issue Search
description: Introduced semantic search capabilities in Copilot Chat, allowing users to find and navigate issues more intelligently using natural language queries.

title: Version 0.132.0
description: Python SDK now supports first-class authentication, Python turn APIs easier to use for text-only workflows, codex exec resume accepts --output-schema, TUI startup is faster, and remote executor registration can use standard Codex auth.

title: Version 0.131.0
description: TUI now offers richer session controls and display, @ mentions search files/directories/plugins/skills in one picker, plugin workflows gained marketplace CLI commands, and remote workflows support daemon-managed codex remote-control.

title: Composer 2.5
description: A substantial improvement in intelligence and behavior over Composer 2, better at sustained work on long-running tasks and follows complex instructions more reliably.

community_feedback.quote: Composer 2.5 is my new default. It is fast, accurate, and actually cheap
around 80% of their work now uses Composer 2.5
Composer 2.5 is still nowhere near SOTA models

title: Version 2.3.9
description: Fixed availability issues with swe-check model, improved terminal processing performance, restored conversation sharing, and repaired path resolution for Devin local agent on WSL.

title: May 2026 Platform Updates
description: Major platform updates including Platform Default Settings, Slack Channel Override, MCP OAuth Resource Parameter, Custom RRULE Schedule Input, GitLab Interactive PR Review, PR Review Status API, In-App Support Dialog, and many more enterprise features and improvements.

community_feedback.quote: Where did Devin go? What does it say about the future of AI dev tools?
Devin's code quality was poor and it took longer than a human developer
Devin is unusable for those without deep knowledge of the codebase

title: Version 0.86.0
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4, gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17, and openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2 model. Improved /clear and /undo commands, fixed settings replacement and analytics.

title: Version 0.42.0
description: Auto Memory Inbox with new inbox flow and canonical-patch contract, Gemma 4 models enabled by default, and Voice Mode Enhancements with wave animations and privacy/compliance UX warnings.

title: Version 2.2.17 - Claude Opus 4.7 Fast Mode
description: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) is now available in Windsurf.

title: Agent View
description: The `claude agents` command opens one screen for every Claude Code session, showing what's running, what's blocked on you, and what's done.

community_feedback.quote: A 500k line codebase for an agent CLI proves one thing: making a probabilistic LLM behave deterministically is a massive state-management nightmare
Claude Code and the Great Productivity Panic of 2026 - people running 6-7 agents simultaneously

title: /goal Command
description: The `/goal` feature keeps Claude working across turns until a completion condition holds, providing persistent goal tracking throughout sessions.

title: Fast Mode on Opus 4.7
description: Fast mode now runs on Opus 4.7 by default, offering improved performance for accelerated execution of Claude Code tasks.

title: Rewind Menu - Summarize Feature
description: The Rewind menu can now compress earlier context with 'Summarize up to here' feature, providing better context management.

title: Version 2.1.32 - Devin Review & Agent Command Center
description: All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review. Added Agent Command Center with list display option, improved sessions sidebar sorting and filtering.
